name: govpay-console
description: GovPay Web Console v2 — backoffice Link.it (Angular 21+, standalone, signals, TailwindCSS, Material).

scripts.start:dev: npm run build:meta && GP_BACKEND=dev-cloud ng serve govpay-console --proxy-config proxy.config.js
scripts.start:demo: npm run build:meta && GP_BACKEND=demo ng serve govpay-console --proxy-config proxy.config.js
scripts.start:local-alt: npm run build:meta && GP_BACKEND=local-alt ng serve govpay-console --proxy-config proxy.config.js
scripts.start:demo-v2: npm run build:meta && GP_BACKEND=demo-v2 ng serve govpay-console --proxy-config proxy.config.js
scripts.start:port: npm run build:meta && ng serve govpay-console --port 5300 --proxy-config proxy.config.js
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:meta && ng build govpay-console --configuration production
scripts.a11y: node "${A11Y_TOOL:?set A11Y_TOOL to the gov-a11y checkout path}/a11y-scan.mjs" --base ${A11Y_BASE:-http://localhost:4200} --config ./ci/a11y/targets.json --out ./a11y-report --tags wcag2a,wcag2aa,wcag21a,wcag21aa,wcag22aa --fail-on serious --no-incomplete
scripts.a11y:full: node "${A11Y_TOOL:?set A11Y_TOOL to the gov-a11y checkout path}/a11y-scan.mjs" --base ${A11Y_BASE:-http://localhost:4200} --config ./ci/a11y/targets.json --out ./a11y-report --tags wcag2a,wcag2aa,wcag21a,wcag21aa,wcag22aa --fail-on serious --fail-on-nameless --screen-reader --lighthouse --no-incomplete
scripts.license:update-year: find projects/govpay-console/src scripts -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -exec sed -i 's/Copyright (c) [0-9]\{4\} Link.it/Copyright (c) 2026 Link.it/g' {} +
